prompt: Create a single horizontal battery icon for a retro music player theme. One battery only, centered, viewed straight-on, glossy purple fill inside a dark metallic gunmetal shell with subtle beveling. Clean crisp edges, no jagged pixels, no glow outside the battery, no drop shadow below the battery, no text, no lightning bolt, no plug, no extra objects. The icon should feel premium and slightly skeuomorphic, matching a dark purple iPod-inspired UI. Keep the battery geometry stable and symmetrical so it can be reused for many battery levels.
style: high-resolution UI asset, dark skeuomorphic interface icon
composition: single centered icon on a plain black background with generous empty margin around it
lighting: soft studio highlight on the battery glass, restrained contrast
palette: purple fill, charcoal shell, subtle silver highlight only inside the bezel
constraints: exactly one battery icon; horizontal orientation; consistent shell thickness all around; no background texture; no perspective tilt; no external shadow; no extra symbols
negative: multiple batteries, text, labels, lightning bolt, charging cable, glow bloom, white underline, cropped edges, perspective distortion

prompt: Create a single compact battery indicator icon for a classic media player skin. Dark graphite outer shell with slightly rounded corners, vivid purple liquid-like fill, subtle glass highlight, very clean baseline, and no decoration outside the body. This asset will be scaled down to a tiny status-bar icon, so the silhouette must remain extremely clean and readable.
composition: single isolated battery icon centered on solid black background
palette: deep purple fill with dark steel bezel
constraints: one icon only; stable rectangular silhouette; no white line beneath it; no cast shadow; no text; no plug; no lightning
negative: extra icons, multiple objects, glow, floor reflection, underline, charging symbols, noisy background

prompt: Generate one polished battery icon for a dark purple portable music player interface. The battery should have a dark neutral outer frame and a rich purple internal bar, with a minimal top terminal nub. Keep the outer silhouette compact and flat, no perspective, no tilt. Make the image suitable as source art for a tiny bitmap UI battery with many percentage levels.
composition: single object centered with empty black background
lighting: gentle top highlight only within the battery body
constraints: single battery only, no white line under the icon, no external drop shadow, no cable, no plug, no lightning, no text
negative: double batteries, multiple levels shown at once, borders outside the silhouette, glows, perspective effects, reflections on the ground
